Do not change the budget size, the guard-retry rule, or request_budget_remaining semantics while no turn is active (it returns the full budget). Make sure opening() is unaffected. Keep it small.

TESTS (add to tests/test_recovery_budget.py; test names must contain the word reset or outside): (a) after a successful engine turn that used both sends, a direct provider call outside a turn is not blocked by the budget; (b) the same after a turn that failed closed with budget exhausted; (c) the next engine turn gets a fresh budget of 2. Hermetic, stub the transport, no network. Each must fail on the current code where it exercises the defect; say which in the notes.
